problem_statement: Provisioned resources alone do not make a gateway-managed model usable from Foundry.
hypothesis: An engineer can configure a project-scoped connected model using managed identities, invoke GPT-5.4 through APIM from Foundry, and correlate the response with successful gateway backend evidence.
customer_scenario: Engineers testing Foundry connected models through an existing API Management gateway, with a backend project for Foundry portal navigation.
data_requirements: One harmless connectivity prompt with a unique test marker. No customer data, ingestion, or evaluation dataset.
security_notes: Project managed identity is the permitted APIM caller; APIM uses account-scoped backend inference access and managed-identity telemetry ingestion. No API keys, policy bypass, or prompt/response body logging. Responses requires the applicable feature flight. GlobalStandard inference may process outside Sweden. Settings and test evidence are ignored by Git.
setup_time_estimate: 5-10 minutes for local setup; Azure provisioning time varies, especially APIM.
